title: Car Culture is in US: Goodyear’s Guide to The 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show
summary: Goodyear-equipped vehicles from leading automotive brands showcase performance and innovation in the center of U.S. car culture, Southern California
body_markdown:
Goodyear-equipped vehicles from leading automotive brands showcase performance and innovation in the center of U.S. car culture, Southern California


**LOS ANGELES, November 20, 2026** – From American performance and capable trucks to family SUVs and the latest electric vehicles, Goodyear tires will be featured on some of the most exciting vehicles at the 2026 Los Angeles Auto Show, running Nov. 20-29 at the Los Angeles Convention Center.


Vehicles from multiple automotive brands will be equipped with Goodyear tires, demonstrating the breadth of Goodyear’s relationships with vehicle manufacturers and its role in helping deliver the performance, capability and driving experience designed into today’s vehicles.


“Southern California is one of the spiritual homes of American car culture, influencing the industry with transformative designs, high performance and the latest trends,” said Dennis Wright, Head of OE Consumer Tires, Americas. “Goodyear has been a part of this world from the beginning, with tires worth bragging about, providing industry-leading performance, responsive ride and handling, and confident capability. We encourage anyone nearby to come out to the Los Angeles Auto Show to check out the Goodyear-equipped vehicles, located in nearly every area of the show.”


Maps to the show, tickets and more can be found at the[show's site](https://laautoshow.com/) , but before you go, here are a few Goodyear-equipped standouts to look out for:


**Ford Bronco Filson: Rugged Style With Three Legendary Brands (Ford, Filson, Goodyear!)**


Located in West Hall, the 2027 Ford Bronco Filson is a premium version of the 6th generation SUV, created in partnership with Filson, the Seattle-based maker of Unfailing Goods, which combines serious off-road capability with a distinctive style. Powering this beast is a specially tuned twin-turbo 3.0-liter EcoBoost V6, and it features Goodyear Wrangler Territory RT tires, sized LT315/70R17.


For more information on the Ford Bronco lineup, please visit[http://www.ford.com/suvs/bronco](http://www.ford.com/suvs/bronco)


**Volkswagen Taos: Efficient, Compact SUV, Completed With Goodyear**


In South Hall, the new 2027 Volkswagen Taos, finished in Bright Moss Green Metallic, is an eye-catcher, with available all-wheel drive, a turbocharged engine, and Goodyear Assurance Finesse, sized 235/45R19.


For more information about the Taos, please visit[https://www.vw.com/en/models/taos.html](https://www.vw.com/en/models/taos.html)


**Ram 1500 TRX SRT: Muscle-Truck Performance Takes Over Off-Road**


Also in South Hall, the 2027 Ram 1500 TRX SRT is ready to tackle nearly any off-road terrain, thanks to a supercharged V8 with 777 horsepower and 680 lb.-ft. of torque. Putting that power to the ground are Goodyear Wrangler Territory AT tires, sized LT325/65R18.


For more information on the 2027 Ram lineup, please visit[https://www.ramtrucks.com/](https://www.ramtrucks.com/)


**Machina Lassen: New manufacturing techniques, new look, final touch provided by Goodyear**


In the South Hall Atrium, showgoers can be the first to check out a new concept from renowned defense contractor Machina Labs, which has applied their new manufacturing techniques to create the Lassen, which is based on a Toyota Tacoma, redesigned by the world-renowned CALLUM team, and built using robotics and AI. Inspired by the unique volcanic topography and landscape of the national park, Lassen features an entirely customized body that went from digital design to a fully personalized body in just three weeks using Machina’s RoboCraftsman platform. Completing the custom design is a set of aggressive Goodyear Wrangler Boulder MTs, sized 35 x 12.5 R18LT.


For more information about Machina, please visit[https://machinalabs.ai/applications/automotive](https://machinalabs.ai/applications/automotive)


**Honda Prelude: Legendary Name, Legendary Tires**


Also located in the South Hall, the 6th generation Honda Prelude, the first-ever hybrid version, is inspired by the fun-to-drive performance, legacy of innovation and dynamic styling of earlier generations of the sports coupe. Prelude is the first model to pair the award-winning Honda two-motor hybrid-electric powertrain with high-performance chassis hardware from the iconic Civic Type R sports machine. Providing grip are Goodyear Eagle Touring tires, size 235/40R19 96V.


For more information about the Honda Prelude Hybrid, please visit[https://automobiles.honda.com/prelude](https://automobiles.honda.com/prelude)


**Goodyear Across the Show Floors**


Goodyear’s presence extends beyond these vehicles. Visitors will find Goodyear-equipped vehicles from manufacturers such as Acura, Dodge, Genesis, GMC, Jeep, Kia, Ram, Rivian and Tesla, as well as custom and vintage vehicles throughout the show, underscoring the range of performance cars, trucks, SUVs and EVs on display from yesterday, today and tomorrow. Even a West Coast Customs-modified LA County Bus features Goodyear Metro Mile tires.


See that one in Kentia Hall, below South Hall.


The breadth and variety of those vehicles reflect the work Goodyear does with automakers to develop tires for different vehicles and applications, helping deliver the performance and driving characteristics expected by drivers in Southern California and around the world.


Follow @Goodyear on X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Threads for highlights of Goodyear-equipped vehicles from across the show floor.

**About The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company**


Goodyear is one of the world’s largest tire companies. It employs about 60,000 people and manufactures its products in 46 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry.
